world_sim.dialogue.steward.greet.1: Stop there, friend. This is the gate of %1$s, and I keep it.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.greet.2: Who comes? The gate of %1$s is no idle place; state your business to me.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.invite.1: Your bones will do; you meet our rules. Will you join %1$s as an outer disciple?
world_sim.dialogue.steward.invite.2: We are taking outer disciples. If you wish to join %1$s, I will enter your name.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.sect_i: This sect takes no one any more.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.alread: You are one of us already; no need to join twice.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.member: Your name is on another sect's roll. Settle that first.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.not_aw: Your spiritual root has not awakened. Go and find your chance first.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.realm_: You cannot even sense qi yet. Come back when you feel the world's spirit.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.select: We choose our disciples: an outstanding root, or Qi Refining at least. Train some years more.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.rejoin: You left us not long ago. We do not take back those who turn round; come again in some years.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.standi: Your standing with this sect is spoiled. I cannot enter your name.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.inacti: The heavens are clouded; we take no one now. Come another day.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.not_me: You are not of this sect; there is nothing to leave.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.at_war: Your sect and ours are at war. This gate receives no enemies. Go back.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.refuse.hostil: You have made yourself an enemy of this sect. You are not welcome here.
world_sim.dialogue.elder.refuse.at_war.1: Our sects are at war. I have nothing to say to you.
There is bad blood between you and this sect. Do not linger here.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.welcome.1: Good. From today you are an outer disciple of %1$s. Learn the rules and do not shame us.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.member.1: Ah, our %1$s. Back on the mountain?
world_sim.dialogue.steward.member.2: %1$s, all is quiet here. Mind your cultivation.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.leave_ask.1: If you mean to leave, I can strike your name. Your standing will suffer, and you may not return for three years.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.farewell_left: Your name is struck. Your bond with %1$s ends here; take care of yourself.
world_sim.dialogue.elder.greet.1: I am an elder of %1$s. If you wish to join, find the gate steward.
world_sim.dialogue.elder.greet.2: This is a quiet place of %1$s. Ask the gate steward about joining.
world_sim.dialogue.elder.member.1: Hm, our %1$s. Cultivate with care; time is short.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.offer.1: There is a task to be done: %1$s, %2$s. Will you take it?
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.offer.2: The stewards' hall has an errand: %1$s, %2$s. Do it and your contribution will be noted.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.progress: Your %1$s is not done yet: %2$s/%3$s. Come back when it is.
%1$s at %2$s/%3$s? No hurry; finish it first.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.ready.1: %1$s done? Let me see, and I will note your contribution.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.none_thi: You have had your task this year. Cultivate, and come again next year.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.accepted: Good, %1$s is yours: %2$s. Report to me when it is done.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.done.1: %1$s, well done. Your contribution rises by %2$s.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.refuse.n: You are not of this sect; our tasks are not yours.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.refuse.t: You have a task in hand already. Finish that one first.
One a year, and you have had yours.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.refuse.n: There is nothing to hand out just now.
It is not done yet, and you come to report?
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.refuse.t: The stones are short. Bring the full count of low-grade spirit stones.
world_sim.dialogue.steward.task.refuse.i: The heavens are clouded; tasks must wait. Come another day.
world_sim.dialogue.elder.apprentice.offe: You have been in the inner gate a while with no master to guide you. I am %1$s; will you be my disciple?
world_sim.dialogue.elder.apprentice.done: Good. From now on you are the disciple of %1$s. Come to me with what you do not understand.
world_sim.dialogue.elder.apprentice.refu: You are not of this sect; I take no outsiders.
You are still an outer disciple. Reach the inner gate first, then speak of a master.
You have a master already; you cannot bow to another.
I am seldom on the mountain these days; we will speak of disciples later.
The heavens are clouded; another day.

fate.myvillage.sword_obsession.descripti: Sword melee hits build momentum; a finishing hit at full stacks launches a sword wave. Timeout or weapon swap clears the streak; derived waves never build stacks or trigger further procs.

fate.myvillage.fire_spirit_body.descript: Direct health damage applies attributed burning; repeated hits on the same target trigger a burst. Burning and bursts never build stacks or trigger more procs.

exploration.myvillage.none: No exploration profile for this dimension.
exploration.myvillage.advice_only: Location realms are advice. Administrators may opt into native portal gates. Use /exploration guide for your next step.
exploration.myvillage.guide.title: %s · Town Guide
exploration.myvillage.guide.complete: You have completed the End route. Build, forge, or consult the optional elder guardian, wither and warden branches.
exploration.myvillage.guide.label: Town Guide
exploration.myvillage.guide.not_ready: The town guide is not currently assigned. Load the inn and guest rooms, then try again.
exploration.myvillage.guide.awaken: Use a Spirit Testing Stele to awaken your spiritual root.
exploration.myvillage.guide.initiate: Receive Basic Breathing at a Technique Inheritance Stele.
exploration.myvillage.guide.qi_explore: Reach Qi Refining 4 and obtain iron. Explore nearby mines and gather forging materials.
exploration.myvillage.guide.qi_late: Reach Qi Refining 7; try normal trials and prepare medicines.
exploration.myvillage.guide.foundation: Consolidate stability and advance to early Foundation before a sustained Nether expedition.
exploration.myvillage.guide.nether: Prepare fire resistance, gold gear and return coordinates, then enter the Nether.
exploration.myvillage.guide.fortress: Find a Nether fortress and obtain a blaze rod. Early–middle Foundation is advised.
exploration.myvillage.guide.stronghold: Craft eyes of ender and locate a stronghold. Prepare a safe return route.
exploration.myvillage.guide.golden: Advance to early Golden Core before your first End expedition.
exploration.myvillage.guide.dragon: Prepare for the dragon: destroy its crystals before fighting the body, then explore the outer islands through a gateway.
exploration.myvillage.tip.awakening: The Spirit Testing Stele opens awakening; it does not teach a core technique.
exploration.myvillage.tip.safety: Set a bed, carry food and light your shelter before long trips.
exploration.myvillage.tip.breathing: Basic Breathing lets you begin the cultivation loop.
exploration.myvillage.tip.meditation: Use the cultivation panel to accumulate progress, then consolidate stability.
exploration.myvillage.tip.mining: Deep caves supply dark iron; riverbanks supply edge-tempering sand.
exploration.myvillage.tip.forging: Use a pattern book to learn it permanently, then forge at a ding.
exploration.myvillage.tip.trial: Normal trials are advised at Qi Refining 7–9; ominous trials at middle–late Foundation.
exploration.myvillage.tip.alchemy: Learn a formula once; herbs from exploration can be planted and harvested.
exploration.myvillage.tip.stability: Full cultivation progress alone is not enough; stability must also meet the advancement requirement.
exploration.myvillage.tip.nether: Portals are unrestricted by default; server owners can opt into realm gates. Fire resistance still matters.
exploration.myvillage.tip.fire: Realm health does not grant lava or fire immunity.
exploration.myvillage.tip.gold: Gold equipment helps with ordinary piglins; do not rely on it against brutes.
exploration.myvillage.tip.fortress: Block wither skeleton approaches and establish cover before fighting blazes.
exploration.myvillage.tip.conversion: Craft one spirit copper ingot from a copper ingot, blaze powder and a low-grade spirit stone. Qi infusion remains an alternative.
exploration.myvillage.tip.eyes: Eyes of ender combine ender pearls and blaze powder; keep extras for the portal.
exploration.myvillage.tip.return: Write down your portal coordinates and protect the route.
exploration.myvillage.tip.golden: Golden Core is the proposed End stage; improve gear and arts alongside realm.
exploration.myvillage.tip.end: Void falls remain lethal regardless of realm.
exploration.myvillage.tip.void: Bring blocks and an escape plan for levitation and void edges.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.overworld: Establish shelter, food and tools. Local monsters follow the regional realm.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.caves: Bring light, a shield and a retreat route; deep caves contain dark iron.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.lush_caves: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.dripstone_: Watch ledges and dripstone. Realm does not remove fall damage.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.ocean: Prepare air, visibility and a way back. Health cannot replace oxygen.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.village: Trade and resupply. Protect villagers and avoid an unprepared raid.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.ruined_por: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.buried_tre: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.trail_ruin: Bring a brush and avoid breaking suspicious blocks.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.igloo: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.shipwreck: Check your air and exit before searching the hold.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.ocean_ruin: Prepare air and watch drowned; their tridents scale with their realm.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.desert_pyr: Inspect pressure plates and TNT. Realm advice does not make traps safe.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.jungle_tem: Look for tripwires and dispensers before opening chests.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.swamp_hut: Prepare for potion effects rather than relying only on health.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.mineshaft: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.dungeon: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.outpost: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.mansion: Prepare for evokers, vexes and axe attacks; avoid pulling several rooms.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.stronghold: Bring eyes of ender and an exit. The End is advised at early Golden Core; boss tuning follows later.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.trial: Complete a normal trial first. An ominous bottle deliberately raises the challenge.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.ominous_tr: Ominous spawners use a separate realm band. Bring supplies and an exit.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.raid: Protect villagers. Raiders retain their birth realm when moved.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.monument: Bring water breathing, night vision, milk and an underwater exit. Elder guardians are optional; use /exploration guide side.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.deep_dark: Avoid repeated shrieker activations. Sneaking, wool and an exit are safer than a direct fight.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.ancient_ci: Sneak, use wool and keep an escape route. Killing a warden is not required for exploration or the main route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.nether: Early Foundation advised. Bring fire resistance, gold gear and return coordinates; lava remains dangerous.
exploration.myvillage.location.nether_ha: Soul sand valley and basalt deltas
exploration.myvillage.prepare.nether_haz: Watch ranged attacks, slowing ground and lava drops; establish a safe route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.nether_lan: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.fortress: Bring fire resistance and watch wither skeletons. Blaze powder, copper and spirit stone craft spirit copper.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.bastion: Piglin brutes are dangerous. Prepare for late Foundation in treasure areas; stealth remains useful.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.end: Ordinary island endermen use an independent End band. Bring ranged tools, supplies and safe footing before destroying crystals; the void remains lethal.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.end_city: Plan cover, safe landings and protection against levitation and falls. End ships retain their elytra value.
message.myvillage.life.reason.guide_serv: Helping travelers at the inn reception.
exploration.myvillage.guide.islands: Use an End gateway to reach the outer islands; bring blocks, pearls and a safe return plan.
exploration.myvillage.guide.end_city: Find an End city, deal with shulkers carefully and secure your footing before looting.
exploration.myvillage.guide.elytra: Find a city with an End ship, retrieve an elytra, and prepare fireworks and repairs.
exploration.myvillage.guide.side_hint: [Optional branches: elder guardian / wither / warden] Click for advice and preparation; these do not block the main route.
exploration.myvillage.portal.denied: Native portal realm gates are enabled here. You need at least %s; returning to the Overworld remains unrestricted.
exploration.myvillage.prepare.end_outer: Bring pearls, blocks and return coordinates. Outer-island mobs do not inherit Overworld region bands; avoid staring at endermen.
exploration.myvillage.tip.dragon: Crystals heal the dragon. Deal with crystals and cages first; perched and flying phases have different hit conditions.
exploration.myvillage.tip.flying_sword: A flying sword helps with controlled ascent and viewing crystals. Existing combat moves are unavailable while mounted; plan crystal removal and ground attacks separately.
exploration.myvillage.tip.islands: Enter gateways with pearls or a suitable approach. Record landing and return points, and keep spare pearls.
exploration.myvillage.tip.shulkers: Shulkers cause levitation. Bring slow falling, pearls and cover; secure your landing before engaging elevated targets.
exploration.myvillage.tip.storage: Shells and a chest make a shulker box. Portable storage and finite city chests reward exploration; opened chests do not refill.
exploration.myvillage.tip.elytra: Only cities with an End ship offer an elytra. Clear nearby shulkers before taking it and keep return supplies.
exploration.myvillage.tip.flight: Elytra offer unmounted long-distance gliding and firework boosts. Prepare durability, rockets and landing sites; controlled sword ascent serves a different purpose.
exploration.myvillage.tip.elder: Monuments are optional. Clear guardians and open a retreat before handling elder beams and thorns; avoid being surrounded underwater.
exploration.myvillage.tip.underwater: Water breathing and night vision help underwater. Milk removes mining fatigue and your other potion effects, so prepare another breathing potion.
exploration.myvillage.tip.wither: Before summoning, clear important buildings and allies from the area. Bring sustained healing, ranged and close attacks, and supplies against the wither effect.
exploration.myvillage.tip.wither_arena: The summoning blast precedes the fight; attack eligibility changes at low health. Use a separate arena with an exit, away from towns.
exploration.myvillage.tip.warden: A direct warden fight is optional and never blocks the guide route. Sneak for loot, use wool to control sound and retreat promptly.
exploration.myvillage.tip.stealth: Warden sonic attacks pass through walls. Armor does not replace distance and an escape plan; a cramped shelter is not a safe zone.

screen.myvillage.atlas.failed: The atlas could not be drawn. See the log.
screen.myvillage.atlas.unavailable: This world has no cultivation worldplan atlas.
screen.myvillage.atlas.outside: You are outside the atlas. The core regions remain visible.
screen.myvillage.atlas.other_dimension: Overworld atlas; you are in another dimension.
